title: The Titan's Curse
author: Rick Riordan
summary: The third Percy Jackson book. A pair of demigods in danger, a missing goddess and a prophecy put Percy and his friends on a road trip across America, with a legion of monsters and some new allies in the way.
readIf: you like fast, jokey myth adventures with real stakes and lots of quests.
skipIf: you haven't read the earlier books, since this series builds on them directly.

pairings.reason: Another young-reader fantasy with a bold quest, though more philosophical and slower to unfold.
A classic chosen-hero fantasy for teens, with dragons in place of gods and a similar pace.
A more cosy, old-fashioned adventure with brave heroes, big battles and feasts.
